scenes.title: What stays the same, and why

beats.say: Two: no-show replacements remain a goodwill gesture, up to three a week. We nurture clients through consistent WhatsApp messages and notifications, and they can opt in or out at any time. If we cannot reschedule, we will replace the lead through our goodwill process.
beats.caption: 2: goodwill means supporting you beyond delivery. Consistent WhatsApp nurturing and opt-in or opt-out help us spot attendance problems early. For a no-show, reschedule first; if that cannot be arranged, replace through our goodwill process, up to 3 a week.
